sentences.text: This case does not admit to be referred to the Special Mediation Drive as the petitioners seeking deferment of payment of compensation to the private respondents No. 3 to 8 on the plea of pending partition proceedings under 2021:JKLHC-JMU:12158-DB Land Revenue Act, Svt. 1996 before Collector Agrarian Reforms, Jammu.

03. List this case before this Court for consideration on 28.08.2025.
